Specifies files and directories for Git to ignore in the Python backend project.

# Purpose
The file is a `.gitignore` file used in a Git repository to specify files and directories that Git should ignore. It includes patterns for ignoring Python bytecode files (`*.pyc`), cache directories (`__pycache__`, `.mypy_cache`, `.cache`), coverage reports (`.coverage`, `htmlcov`), Python package metadata (`app.egg-info`), and virtual environment directories (`.venv`). This helps to prevent unnecessary files from being tracked in version control.
